mentions.name: SlashLink
mentions.description: A simple pay-as-you-go Amazon link localizer for affiliate marketers, positioned as a cheaper alternative to Genius; built on Cloudflare Workers with SQLite (D1).
mentions.problem: Existing Amazon link localization tools like Genius are more expensive.
